lessons: Never probe a not-yet-created public hostname from the home network before the apply: the ISP resolver caches the negative answer for the zone's SOA minimum (1800 s) and the in-cluster edge probes inherit it.
Re-running a restore from the same directory needs the previous run's diagnostics rotated (rotate_run_files), otherwise decrypt_into refuses to overwrite them.
Apply Cloudflare before the gitops host-set switch: the reverse order points config.js at an unresolvable host and fails the edge probes.
